sources.description: IPA pronunciations for the Story Bible's pronunciation feature, read from your own computer with no internet connection, between the CMU dictionary and the eSpeak NG letter-to-sound guess.
sources.pending: No release is pinned. kaikki.org, en.wiktionary.org and dumps.wikimedia.org were unreachable when this was checked (HTTP 403 from the egress proxy, 2026-11-03), so no archive URL, size or SHA-256 has been read. Pin one by downloading the English extract and filling in url, sha256, size, expand and installedSize (docs/research/wiktextract-pronunciation-source.md).
